secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI features (receipt OCR, procurement forecasting, assistant, Berita Acara drafting). Optional — the app boots and falls back to local heuristic responses when unset, but AI features need it for real results. Obtain from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

secrets.name: APP_URL
secrets.description: Public URL where the app is hosted (used for self-referential links). Optional; defaults to http://localhost:3000.
